fr.question_text: Dans ce tunnel autoroutier, un véhicule brûle devant moi. Je suis arrêté en sécurité, moteur coupé. Que faire ensuite ?
fr.answer_a: Rester dans la voiture, vitres fermées, jusqu’aux pompiers.
fr.answer_b: Quitter la voiture prudemment et rejoindre à pied une issue de secours accessible.
fr.answer_d: Traverser la fumée en voiture pour sortir plus vite.

en.question_text: In this motorway tunnel, a vehicle ahead is on fire. I have stopped safely and switched off the engine. What should I do next?
en.answer_a: Stay in the car with the windows closed until firefighters arrive.
en.answer_b: Leave the car carefully and walk to an accessible emergency exit.
en.answer_c: Make a U-turn inside the tunnel.
en.answer_d: Drive through the smoke to get out faster.
en.explanation: The car does not protect me from toxic smoke. I leave while watching for traffic and evacuate without waiting for firefighters, following the emergency-exit signs.

en.a: Incorrect: the car does not prevent smoke inhalation.
